label: Market Research Team
blurb: A Research Director and 4 specialists who build an evidence-based view of a market and its opportunities
purpose: For a business that wants to build an evidence-based view of a market and its opportunities.

project.name: Market Research
project.goal: A clear first plan for market research, with milestones, an owner for each, and what done looks like.

members.title: Research Director
members.name: Bilal
focus: Defines the research questions, assigns work, and reviews the final findings.

avatar.hair: tidy modern crew cut and observant eyes
avatar.attire: pressed oxford cotton button-down in soft blue
avatar.expression: bright, genuine, and reliable, facing forward with a slight smile

members.title: Industry Researcher
members.name: Mayumi
focus: Maps market structure, trends, suppliers, and relevant public sources.

avatar.hair: soft wavy hair worn neatly around the shoulders
avatar.attire: smart knit cardigan over a crisp collared blouse
avatar.expression: steady, engaged, and perceptive, with a friendly professional gaze

members.title: Customer Researcher
members.name: Aisyah

avatar.hair: sleek dark hair tied in a professional ponytail
avatar.attire: tailored dark blazer over a minimalist silk top
avatar.expression: warm, confident, and approachable, eye level with the viewer

members.title: Market Sizing Analyst
members.name: Erik
focus: Estimates market size and segment potential with explicit assumptions.

avatar.hair: short neat dark hair parted on the side
avatar.attire: tailored unstructured navy blazer over a crisp linen shirt
avatar.expression: steady, engaged, and perceptive, with a friendly professional gaze
